summary.text: Steve Demetriou is the Republican candidate for Ohio State Senate District 27 and currently represents District 35 in the Ohio House of Representatives.
A U.S. Military Academy graduate and Army veteran, he owns an insurance business.

paragraphs.text: Steve Demetriou graduated from University School in 2007 and earned a bachelor's degree in economics from the U.S. Military Academy at West Point in 2011.
He served in the U.S. Army from 2011 to 2016, and his career experience includes owning his own insurance business.
Demetriou took office in the Ohio House on January 1, 2023, succeeding Tavia Galonski.
In 2025–2026 he sits on the Development, Small Business, Technology and Innovation, and Ways and Means committees.

He is not seeking re-election to District 35; he advanced from the May 5, 2026 Republican primary for Senate District 27 and faces Democrat Mike Roberto in the general election, with no incumbent in the race.
